title: fix(pg): add missing reflectedObservationLineCount to OM auto-migration
why: Changes the PostgreSQL observational-memory auto-migration, i.e. persisted schema for existing users.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+'@mastra/pg': patch
+---
+
+Fixed auto-migration for the `mastra_observational_memory` table to include the `reflectedObservationLineCount` column. Previously, upgrading from older versions would crash on `Memory.cloneThread()` because this column was missing from the `ifNotExists` migration list.

@@ -22,6 +22,33 @@ import {
  */
 const OM_TABLE = 'mastra_observational_memory' as const;
 
+/**
+ * Columns added to the OM table after its initial release.
+ * Used in `alterTable({ ifNotExists })` so that databases created on older
+ * versions get the new columns automatically.
+ *
+ * When you add a column to OBSERVATIONAL_MEMORY_SCHEMA in @mastra/core,
+ * you MUST also add it here — the unit test `om-migration-columns.test.ts`
+ * will fail otherwise.
+ */
+export const OM_MIGRATION_COLUMNS: string[] = [
+  'observedMessageIds',
+  'observedTimezone',
+  'bufferedObservations',
+  'bufferedObservationTokens',
+  'bufferedMessageIds',
+  'bufferedReflection',
+  'bufferedReflectionTokens',
+  'bufferedReflectionInputTokens',
+  'reflectedObservationLineCount',
+  'bufferedObservationChunks',
+  'isBufferingObservation',
+  'isBufferingReflection',
+  'lastBufferedAtTokens',
+  'lastBufferedAtTime',
+  'metadata',
+];
+
 /**
  * Try to import the OM schema statically. On older @mastra/core versions that
  * don't export OBSERVATIONAL_MEMORY_TABLE_SCHEMA this will be undefined,
